content.text:
-    1pm: Secretariat arrival
             -    What is our “to do” list?
             -    Material set-up
                       -   Separate into boxes for committee rooms
                       -   Reg Desk
                       -   Rearrange rooms as necessary
             -    Don’t have access to all rooms early
    -    3:30pm: Staff arrival
             -    What are we tasking staff with?
             -    Quick meeting
             -    Set-up
             -    Let us know if they’re missing anything
                       -   Get some dongles and fancy paper from staples - Elliott
    -    4:00pm: Registration opens
             -    Who will sit at the registration desk?
                       -   Frankie, Ann
             -    Who is greeting Major Calvert and when do we expect him to arrive? We
                  need to send him a final note with details re parking, time etc.
                       -   Frankie
                       -   Emailed him the updates and time of arrival
    -    4:30pm-5:00pm: Opening Ceremonies
             -    Speeches look great!
             -    We still need to schedule a quick run-through. Should we do this on Friday
                  afternoon?
                       -   Before materials sorted
             -    Ivan can man the opening ceremony presentation
             -    No banner (logo doesn’t match)
             -    Figure out the presentation set-up, make sure it works
             -    Mr. Anthony intends to be there - have a seat for him close to the stage
                       -   Both Ann and Elliott go up, Elliott says speech, Ann introduces
                           Anthony, Elliott introduces Calvert
             -    Elliott run land acknowledgement by Mrs Point
    -    5pm-6pm: Dinner break and wall re-set- is this all sorted with the Alumni Centre?
             -    Yep
    -    6pm-7:15pm: Committee session #1 & Chaperone meeting (space confirmed?)
             -    Achievement lounge - during last 30 min of first committee session
    -    7:15pm-7:45pm: Break
             -    This is designated as a break, but a stagger release might be advisable. Elliot
                  & James can coordinate this.
             -    Get second floor empty first
